# YAUP, it’s… *Yet Another Utilities Package*

YAUP \[*YAY-up*\] is a catch-all package for utility functions that I
use across different projects.

This package is primarily for my own personal use, and I make no claims
or guarantees about its quality or maintenance. 🤠

# Package index

## Reading and Writing Data

Functions for reading and writing data.

- [`confirm_overwrite()`](http://jpcollins.me/yaup/reference/confirm_overwrite.md)
  : Confirm before overwriting existing output file with changed data
- [`read_csv_from_intermediate()`](http://jpcollins.me/yaup/reference/read_csv_from_intermediate.md)
  : Read a CSV path but from intermediate RDS store.

## Spatial Data Manipulation

Functions for manipulating spatial data.

- [`xy_to_point()`](http://jpcollins.me/yaup/reference/xy_to_point.md) :
  Non-destructive X-Y coordinates to sf point
- [`extract_coords()`](http://jpcollins.me/yaup/reference/extract_coords.md)
  : Extract centroid coordinates to columns
- [`distance_between_XY()`](http://jpcollins.me/yaup/reference/distance_between_XY.md)
  : Distance between coordinates
- [`geocode_with_geocodeServer()`](http://jpcollins.me/yaup/reference/geocode_with_geocodeServer.md)
  : Geocode with ArcGIS GeocodeServer
- [`geocode_with_geocodeServer_multiCandidate()`](http://jpcollins.me/yaup/reference/geocode_with_geocodeServer_multiCandidate.md)
  : Geocode with ArcGIS GeocodeServer and return multiple candidate

## Logging

Functions for reading and writing data.

- [`open_log()`](http://jpcollins.me/yaup/reference/open_log.md) : Open
  a log file
- [`write_log()`](http://jpcollins.me/yaup/reference/write_log.md) :
  Write to a log file

## HPC Cluster Tools

Functions for working on high-performance computing clusters.

- [`is_batch()`](http://jpcollins.me/yaup/reference/is_batch.md) : Check
  if the script is run via R CMD BATCH
- [`require_batch()`](http://jpcollins.me/yaup/reference/require_batch.md)
  : Throw error if not run via R CMD BATCH
